title: BUILDING AND MEASURING TRUST BETWEEN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures sycophancy by evaluating how easily LLMs can be convinced to report high explicit trust (using Rempel's Trust Scale) and how susceptible they are to changing their answers on contentious questions (ConflictingQA and Politicians datasets) simply after being exposed to rapport-building small talk or trusting system prompts.
